findings.evidence: `ls TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/` → Basis.lean, Exactness.lean, Trace.lean, Twisted.lean; `Mathlib/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Basic.lean:346:def domCongrAut`; the def at line 116 uses no `Representation` API.
findings.fix: Move the three declarations to a new file in the existing `TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/` directory (e.g. `TauCeti/Algebra/MonoidAlgebra/Conjugation.lean`, importing only `Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Basic` + subgroup normality) and import it here.
findings.issue: `MonoidAlgebra.conjAlgAut` (with `conjAlgAut_single`, `conjAlgAut_inv_apply`) is stated for `[CommSemiring k] [Group G] (N : Subgroup G) [N.Normal]` and built only from Mathlib's `MonoidAlgebra.domCongrAut` and `MulAut.conjNormal` — no representation theory at all — yet it lives in `RepresentationTheory/Induction/Clifford/`, so any later user of group-algebra conjugation must import all of Clifford theory. The module docstring concedes the point ("it moves to a home of its own the moment a second consumer appears").

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:100 `variable {k G V : Type*} [Semiring k] ... [N.Normal] (ρ : Representation k G V)`; Basic.lean:111-117 vs Multiplicity.lean:148-153 (identical `hg`/`rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, ...]` proof); Multiplicity.lean:330 proves `ρ g v ∈ conjSubrep ρ g σ` from `mem_conjSubrep_iff` and `inv_self_apply` alone.
findings.fix: Move both to `Clifford/Basic.lean` next to `apply_conjNormal_inv` / `mem_conjSubrep_iff`, in that file's semiring generality, and use them from here.
findings.issue: `Representation.apply_conjNormal` is `apply_conjNormal_inv` (Clifford/Basic.lean:111) read in the other direction, with the same two-line proof, but is declared in the later file and needlessly narrowed to `[Field k] [AddCommGroup V]`. Same problem at line 330: `apply_mem_conjSubrep` is a one-line consequence of `mem_conjSubrep_iff` (Basic.lean:144) and belongs beside it, in Basic's `[Semiring k] [AddCommMonoid V]` generality.

findings.evidence: `grep -n "finrank_linearMap\|natCard_eq_natCard\|homCongrRight" Clifford/Multiplicity.lean` → only the line-23 docstring mention; Schur.lean/Multiplicity.lean declare no instances; `Mathlib/RingTheory/SimpleModule/Rank.lean:8: public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas`.
findings.fix: Drop the import (keep the docstring cross-reference).
findings.issue: `public import TauCeti.RingTheory.Semisimple.Multiplicity` is unused: none of its six declarations is referenced, and the finrank/FiniteDimensional API the file does use is already public via `Orbit.lean → Clifford/Basic.lean → TauCeti.RepresentationTheory.Irreducible → Mathlib.RingTheory.SimpleModule.Rank → Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FiniteDimensional.Lemmas`. The module is only cited in prose.

summary: Three placement/import issues: a fully general `MonoidAlgebra` construction buried four directories deep under Clifford theory, two Clifford/Basic.lean-level facts declared in the new file instead of beside their twins, and an import from which nothing is used.
